clues.text: This coaster climbs to a height of 205 feet, hits a top speed of 75 mph, and features zero inversions along its course.
Manufactured by Morgan, this massive ride first opened to riders in 1998.
Riders will find this attraction thrilling guests in the state of Missouri.
This ride ranks as the tallest, fastest, and longest continuous circuit roller coaster in the state of Missouri.
This coaster shares its name with a notoriously fast and venomous African snake.

evidence.quote: Mamba is a steel roller coaster located at Worlds of Fun in Kansas City, Missouri.

It is also currently the tallest, fastest, and longest continuous circuit coaster in the state of Missouri; it is surpassed in height only by Mr. Freeze: Reverse Blast at Six Flags St. Louis, which is a Shuttle roller coaster.
